FEAT principles

Advisory · first published 2018

Fairness, Ethics, Accountability and Transparency in the use of AI and data analytics.

Guidelines on AI Risk Management

Consultation proposal · November 2025

Proposes an AI inventory and proportionate risk management across the lifecycle. A proposal, not an issued rule.

MAS's FEAT principles address Fairness, Ethics, Accountability and Transparency in the use of AI and data analytics. They are advisory principles, first published in 2018. They provide a useful way to examine fair outcomes, responsibility and communication in financial services.

A separate November 2025 consultation proposed Guidelines on AI Risk Management. The proposal includes maintaining an AI inventory and proportionate risk management across the lifecycle. We are discussing that consultation document as a proposal, not presenting it as an issued rule. An organisation using a consultation proposal should check the current issued requirements before relying on it.

For a financial institution, the practical task is to connect AI controls to its existing governance, risk and compliance arrangements. The review should distinguish binding requirements, advisory principles and proposals, rather than treat every MAS publication as having the same legal effect.
